SECF.description: Section Stiffness Scale Factor (SECF). The ITEMS array holds one entry per section-stiffness scale-factor definition; IPART selects which construction-stage part the factors apply to and bDiffIJ toggles whether the J-end (J1-J8) factors differ from the I-end.

ITEMS.description: List of section stiffness scale-factor definitions to assign to the section identified by the key.

ID.description: Serial number of the scale-factor entry within this section key (multiple entries distinguish parts/groups).

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing Boundary Group to associate with this entry. Empty means no group; a non-empty name that does not match an existing Boundary Group is rejected.

AREA_SF.description: I-end scale factor for cross-sectional Area.

ASY_SF.description: I-end scale factor for effective shear area about axis Y (Asy).

ASZ_SF.description: I-end scale factor for effective shear area about axis Z (Asz).

IXX_SF.description: I-end scale factor for torsional resistance (Ixx).

IYY_SF.description: I-end scale factor for area moment of inertia about axis Y (Iyy).

IZZ_SF.description: I-end scale factor for area moment of inertia about axis Z (Izz).

W_SF.description: I-end scale factor for warping constant (W).

IPART.description: Composite-section construction-stage part the factors apply to: 1 = Before only, 2 = After only, 3 = Both Before and After.

bDiffIJ.description: [_CIVIL] When true the J-end factors (J1-J8) differ from the I-end and are applied; when false the J-end mirrors the I-end and J1-J8 are ignored.

J1.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for cross-sectional Area.

J2.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for effective shear area about axis Y (Asy).

J3.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for effective shear area about axis Z (Asz).

J4.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for torsional resistance (Ixx).

J5.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for area moment of inertia about axis Y (Iyy).

J6.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for area moment of inertia about axis Z (Izz).

J8.description: [bDiffIJ=true, _CIVIL] J-end scale factor for warping constant (W).
